summary: This policy outlines the approval process for contracts with new vendors and the handling of initial invoices based on their amounts.

generated_sql_rules.rule_name: Approval for invoices under 1 million JPY
generated_sql_rules.comment: Invoices with amounts less than 1 million JPY can be approved by department heads.
generated_sql_rules.sql_query: SELECT id FROM erp_invoices WHERE raw_amount < 1000000 AND status = 'Unprocessed';

generated_sql_rules.rule_name: Hold for invoices 1 million JPY and above
generated_sql_rules.comment: Invoices with amounts of 1 million JPY or more require executive approval and should be held for escalation.
generated_sql_rules.sql_query: SELECT id FROM erp_invoices WHERE raw_amount >= 1000000 AND status = 'Unprocessed';
